# Dilan Kochhar

> Web developer, AI engineer, and SEO/AEO specialist in Tampa, FL. Designs and builds websites, apps, and AI agents solo, and runs a $500/month Search & AI Visibility retainer (technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data, answer-engine optimization, monthly reporting). Also offers website care plans: security $45/month, maintenance $80/month, or both as Full Care for $100/month. Website builds start at $100/month. Founder of Dilly (trydilly.com), an iPhone and iPad app where kids learn how AI works by teaching their own companion.

## Services

- [Services & pricing](https://dilankochhar.com/#services): Search & AI Visibility retainer, $500/month. Website care plans from $100/month (security, maintenance, or both). Websites from $100/month; apps and AI agents scoped per project.
